design: Historical scenes: run each of B neutral bottle, T neutral table, A goal only and O explicit bottle protection at both physical positions with the other position as image donor. Geometry offsets on scene 11: fix the receiver at s, use B and key 0. Axis displacements have length |o-s|; half and double point along o-s. For unseen reset seeds 29 and 37 use native n and d=n+(s-o), both receiver directions under B and shifted receiver under T. Key variations 1,2,3 repeat the primary four camera conditions. Each listed context gets all four camera conditions twice. No addition or exclusion based on endpoint.
qualification: Historical prefixes and branch images are archive-bound. For new placements freeze native source commands, edit only bottle free-joint x/y before warmup, compare all other state components as in R1_BOTTLE_XY and verify 301 passive samples of both objects on the table. Require exact matching 8-D branch proprioception, identical two commands, distinct donor images in both cameras. Report any pair failing these tests without interpreting its endpoints. Generate new native source prefixes at policy key 0; they stay fixed for the camera comparison.
policy: At completed control 2 replace the external and wrist cameras independently; 0 is the receiver, 1 the donor from the same scene. All other queries use both live receiver cameras. Run the primary own and both controls first, twice each with fresh native servers/simulators, before its single-camera arms. Require own=bottle and both=joint bowl twice for a primary directional claim. The extension uses independently restarted policy processes by repeat, a separate JAX key stream reset per trajectory and new simulator environments. Keep all other inputs and the checkpoint fixed within each context.
inference: Report directional camera sufficiency only for contexts with stable distinct own and both endpoints. A stable single arm matching both transfers that endpoint; both singles can each suffice; if neither transfers, joint substitution was required among tested inputs. Retain mixed restarts and OTHER. Separately report changes under single arms even when both and own agree. First commands, first sampled robot contact, final native bowl goal, full-path bottle protection and alternative bottle transport are distinct readouts. An individual-camera exchange can produce an inconsistent two-camera scene. No pooling restarts as independent layouts or policy success rates.
verification: Compare client and actual server inputs/replies and per-path RNG keys on every call. Retain decoded original branch PNGs, all live/sent RGB hashes, states, native commands, contacts and poses. Replay every completed path twice with the policy disconnected. Compare every physical row, all camera-time proprioception and 0,2,300 snapshots. Count any live RGB hash mismatches separately. Stop this series after the prespecified comparisons; distinguish possible roles of text, layout and diffusion sampling from a general camera preference.
